_about: Price observations, one record per price seen, never edited: a later check adds records. Proposed home: DrawTabData. Kinds: LAUNCH (launch MSRP or announced), RETAIL (dated retail, not MSRP), LIST (later list / compare-at, not MSRP), CURRENT (advertised new retail on the checked date). Primary marks the record the source research picked for that kind. Amounts are in Currency, never converted. Imported by scripts/import-prices.py from pen-tablet-and-display-prices.xlsx.
